During the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Wyrd]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] gathered at an '''encampment''' in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Description==
The encampment was home to around forty [[Wyrd]] members and consisted of a number of huts sited next to a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] network consisting of two caverns. The outer cave was used as living quarters for the [[Coven/Legends|coven's]] senior [[Witch/Legends|witches]] including their leader, the [[First Witch of the Wyrd]]. The cave contained some curtained-off [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] places as well as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies, portable furniture and personal items of the witches. The inner chamber was employed as a religious shrine and work area and contained several scrolls setting out the Wyrd's [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] preachings.<ref name="APOD" />

==History==
By the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Wyrd had suffered various setbacks and were reduced in number, no longer retaining the strength to maintain a permanent settlement.<ref name="APOD" /> Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness|A Plague of Darkness]]'' is set shortly before ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure that occurs concurrently with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''A Plague of Darkness'' can be placed in circa 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the last of the witches gathered at the encampment under the leadership of the First Witch. After receiving teachings from [[Len Markus]], the leader of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]], on how to corrupt Cularin's native [[ch'hala tree]]s, the witches plotted to turn the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and thereby allow them to gain control of the planet's ecology. On of the witches, [[Cheelru]] of the [[Wyrd]]'s [[Inner Circle]] challenged the the plot and was chained up by the First Witch within the inner chamber of the encampment's cave network as punishment.<ref name="APOD" />

The First Witch and a number of her followers departed the camp to proceed with their plan to subvert the ch'hala. The witches that remained at the camp became listless and depressed, assuming that if the scheme to debase the ch'hala trees failed the Wyrd would face [[Death/Legends|death]] and defeat. A group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] ventured to the camp while investigating the Wyrd's plot and after making their way past the guards learned from the captive Cheelru of the witches' plans.<ref name="APOD" />
